content:
kai: Heads up — after the keystore reorganize in eu-west-1, several warmpool GPU nodes failed decrypts and fell out of rotation. Seeing fallback to hosted endpoints and a cost spike. Logs show KMS access denied.

maya: looking. which keystore? the new org-keystore-2025?

kai: yes. rollout started ~09:22 UTC. affected: gpu-pool-eu-warm, gpu-proxy-privnet. Symptoms: nodes repeatedly failing join, warmpool size dropped from 48 -> 6.

ops-jesse: paste failing error log?

kai: ```
2025-03-12T09:27:14Z node-agent ERROR decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789
```

maya: looks like keystore policy removed the kms:Decrypt for the role used by node bootstrap. I see a recent terraform apply by infra/keystore-reorg.

nina: @maya can you confirm which IAM role lost permission? also do we have audit logs for the keystore calls?

maya: role: gpu-node-bootstrap-role. policy change id tf-apply-2025-03-12-09. Audit logs partially available — we lost VPC flow logs to central-proxy during the change because firewall rule 987 blocked outbound 443 from management subnets.

security-lex: Investigating. Firewall change 987 was applied as part of 'tighten-egress-2025' PR. It inadvertently blocked PrivateLink to the keystore. Rolling back rule in progress. :construction: 

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-432 keystore-rollout-decrypt-fail — oncall paged (priority: high).

ops-jesse: rolling back the firewall rule now (running `terraform apply -target=module.firewall.rule_987 -auto-approve`).

maya: rolling back tf change for keystore access too — applying patch to restore kms:Decrypt for gpu-node-bootstrap-role.

kai: note — some services fell back to hosted API endpoints; rough extra cost estimate ~ $9k last hour for eu-west-1 due to egress + hosted model usage. tagging cost owners for chargeback.

nina: For postmortem: add runbook step to verify PrivateLink/KMS decrypt before keystore deploys. Also add a small canary pool exercise (one warm node) to validate.

security-lex: Will add an IAM guardrail to prevent removal of kms:Decrypt from bootstrap roles and a firewall policy test to block PRs that remove PrivateLink access.

maya: rollback complete. warmpool recovering. current warmpool size 42/48.

kai: thanks. keep monitoring — if any node still failing grep for "Not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt" and ping here.

ops-jesse: confirmed no new decrypt errors in logs for 5m. If stable, will close INC-2025-432 in 10m :thumbsup:

kai: adding short blameless note: mis-scoped firewall rule + terraform drift. tagging @product-cost for chargeback.

nina: linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/keystore-deploy-checklist

security-lex: noted, will schedule a follow-up sync and own the postmortem action items.
